rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The Congress of People's Deputies of the RSFSR resolves that, until the RSFSR Law 'On the Council of Ministers of the RSFSR' is adopted, the President of the RSFSR decides on his own, within the budget funds allotted by the Supreme Soviet, questions of reorganising the structure of the highest bodies of executive power (point 2). The resolution takes effect on adoption and ceases on 1 December 1992 (point 5). It names nobody as head of the Government; it is signed by the Chairman of the Supreme Soviet 'Р. И. ХАСБУЛАТОВ'.
rows.locator: Point 2, first paragraph; point 5; signature block (Москва, Кремль, 1 ноября 1991 года, N 1830-I)
